# VictoriaMetrics v1.151.0

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics) and pinned to immutable source commit `83fc70c6aced8c99a0a445a872ee891191b98517`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for VictoriaMetrics v1.151.0.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Pages follow the Hugo `menu.docs` navigation declared in docs/ at the immutable release tag.
- Fragments pulled in by `{{% content %}}` are inlined into the page that renders them and are not published separately.
- Hugo shortcodes are expanded to plain Markdown; presentation-only attribute lists are dropped.
